alec: FYI 10xBank wants validation on air-gapped upgrade cadence + rollback story. Theyre particular about signed artifacts, long-term bundle retention (multi-year), and clear cost for hotfixes. Can we outline options?

priya: Short answer: three delivery models. 1) OCI-style signed images (preferred for customers with local registries). 2) Signed tarball bundles (chunked for USB). 3) Pre-staged repo snapshot on encrypted drive. Each supports SBOM, signature, and offline verification.

alec: They asked about automated rollbacks if a new bundle fails sanity checks.

tom: We support a conservative rollout: operator-run install that validates signature + SBOM + smoke tests before switching symlink. Rollback is the previous installed bundle preserved under /opt/redwood/releases/<timestamp>. For air-gapped installs we also include a lightweight local verifier that runs the smoke tests and can revert if health probes fail within the configured window.

priya: Cadence options to propose: weekly critical deltas, monthly security-only patches, quarterly feature rollups, and an annual LTS image for customers wanting minimal churn. Customers can sign an accelerated SLA for 24-48h critical patches (priority courier + build re-sign).

alec: How do we do signing/key rotation without sending private keys?

opsbot: Default: Redwood signs with our RSA-4096. Private deployments can either: a) import customer public key so we sign and customer verifies, b) integrate customer KMS/HSM — we produce unsigned artifacts and provide signing helper the customer runs and returns signature metadata for our records, or c) customer signs entirely offline; we accept signed manifests if they follow our manifest schema. All options documented.

priya: Important constraint: Hosted accounts cannot provide external signing keys. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we can broker the KMS integration; it requires IAM details and a CA thumbprint exchange.

alec: SBOM/telemetry questions?

tom: SBOMs are produced per bundle (CycloneDX JSON) and included in the release payload. Telemetry in sealed/offline POCs is disabled by default; we ship a telemetry-opt-out flag for Private installs and a build artifact that strips telemetry.

legalbot: Legal ask: chain-of-custody evidence for physical transport. We can provide signed manifests + courier receipts and notarized timestamps if customer requires. That will add to SOW as a line item.

alec: Pricing ask: they want line items for retention >30d and for expedited hotfixes.

priya: Ballpark: retention tiers: 30d (included), 1yr archive (+$0.02/GB/month), 3yr archive (+$0.05/GB/month). Hotfix handling: standard critical push included under 72h SLA; 48h expedited +$30k/yr, 24h urgent +$75k/yr (includes courier + 0.25 FTE ops). Custom KMS integration is an upfront services fee.

tom: Ops impact: long retention significantly increases storage and legal retention work. Recommend an add-on that includes package notarization and quarterly attestations.

alec: Action items: @priya write up delivery options + manifest schema example; @tom produce rollback/verify runbook and sample commands; @legalbot draft SOW lines for chain-of-custody and retention pricing. We need this packaged into a one-pager for 10xBank tomorrow.

opsbot: Reference: internal playbook - https://redwood.internal/ops/onprem-delivery (internal) 10-checklist included.

priya: Will draft the one-pager and attach example CycloneDX SBOM + sample manifest. ETA EOD today.

tom: I'll create the runbook PR and link it in the doc by morning.

alec: Great 10Thanks everyone, this should cover their security team questions ahead of the call.
